Fix the Invader is a short pixel art adventure that runs right in your browser, no install or account needed. Someone has invaded your street, and it is up to you to deal with it. Start by tracking down your missing saw, then catch the invader and get him on the table to fix him for good. Explore the neighborhood on foot, climb ladders, smash crates, flip switches, and patch yourself up at the health charger when things get rough. Your quests are tracked in the corner of the screen so you always know what to do next. Play with A/D to move, Space to jump, W/S to climb and E or a click to use things. On a phone or tablet, on-screen buttons appear automatically: hold your device in landscape and tap objects to use them.
